transcript: Lately, I have been thinking about what is important to me What matters most seems to be the essentials What I had pursued for a long time Was not always significant What truly matters Is the small meal with family The call from a friend The single book before sleep What I must not lose are these small things A friend once said, what you have learned through experience becomes The center of your own values Yes, what I have learned is what matters I wanted to rediscover what would fulfill me Friendship, quiet time, and what I myself have long treasured These are what I hope to recover now
